levels.surface: محمد بن علي بن الحسن بن شقيق

notes: three «ح» branches meet at «الحسين بن واقد»; the tail «عن عبد الله بن بريدة، عن أبيه» is written once, after the last branch, so it closes all three (rule 3)
the second branch's own «عن أبيه» is his father, the bare relation, and the tail's «أبيه» is Abdullah's father; neither is named in the text
the Tirmidhi remarks («وفي الباب عن أنس»، «قال أبو عيسى») are excluded; «رضوان» blessing excluded
